one's native language: Although Ken speaks English very well, Japanese is still his native language, which he learned from his parents.
雖然阿健英文說得很好，日語仍是他從父母那裡學會的母語。
a native speaker: Our school hired a native speaker of English to help students practice speaking and pronunciation.
我們學校聘請了一位英語母語人士來幫助學生練習口說和發音。
be native to Taiwan: The Formosan black bear is native to Taiwan and cannot be found living in the wild anywhere else.
台灣黑熊原產於台灣，在其他任何地方的野外都找不到。
native plants: The park only grows native plants, which are naturally suited to the local climate and need less water.
這座公園只種植原生植物，它們天生適應當地氣候且需要較少的水。
go native: After moving to a small village in Bali, the foreign teacher decided to go native and follow all the local customs.
搬到峇里島的一個小村莊後，那位外籍老師決定入境隨俗，遵循所有當地習俗。
one's native land: After thirty years abroad, the old man finally returned to his native land to spend his last years at home.
在國外生活三十年後，那位老人終於回到故鄉，在家鄉度過晚年。
a neat solution: Using one shared online calendar was a neat solution to the problem of family members forgetting each other's plans.
使用一個共享的線上行事曆，是解決家人忘記彼此計畫這個問題的巧妙簡潔的解決方法。
neat handwriting: Her neat handwriting is so clear and tidy that teachers always enjoy reading her homework.
她整齊的字跡既清楚又工整，老師們總是很喜歡批改她的作業。
a neat idea: Having a picnic on the school rooftop is a neat idea; let's ask the principal if we can do it!
在學校屋頂野餐是個好主意；我們去問校長能不能這麼做吧！
drink whisky neat: My grandfather likes to drink whisky neat, without any ice or water added to the glass.
我爺爺喜歡喝純威士忌，杯裡不加任何冰塊或水。
neat and tidy: Mom always asks me to keep my bedroom neat and tidy, with books on the shelves and clothes put away.
媽媽總是要我保持臥室整潔有序，書要放在書架上，衣服要收好。
needy families: Every winter, our class collects warm clothes and food to give to needy families in the neighborhood.
每年冬天，我們班都會收集保暖衣物和食物，送給社區裡的貧困家庭。
help the needy: The charity uses all its donations to help the needy, such as homeless people and poor elderly citizens.
這個慈善機構把所有捐款用來幫助窮人，例如無家可歸的人和貧困的長者。
an emotionally needy person: An emotionally needy person may text friends constantly and feel upset if they do not reply right away.
一個情感上極需依賴的人可能會不停傳訊息給朋友，如果對方沒有馬上回覆就會感到難過。
remain neutral: When my two best friends started arguing, I decided to remain neutral and not take either side.
當我的兩個好朋友開始爭吵時，我決定保持中立，不偏袒任何一方。
neutral ground: Switzerland has long been seen as neutral ground where countries in conflict can meet and talk about peace.
瑞士長久以來被視為中立地帶，衝突中的國家可以在那裡會面並商談和平。
a neutral color: Gray is a neutral color, so it goes well with almost any other color in your clothes or home.
灰色是中性色，所以幾乎能和你衣服或家中的任何其他顏色搭配。
neutral territory: The peace talks were held in neutral territory so that neither country would feel it had an advantage.
和平談判在中立區舉行，這樣兩國都不會覺得對方佔了優勢。
on neutral ground: To avoid arguing at either family's home, the two families agreed to meet on neutral ground at a quiet café.
為了避免在任何一方家裡爭吵，兩家人同意在中立的地方，也就是一間安靜的咖啡館見面。
a neutral tone: The news reporter described the accident in a neutral tone, without showing any personal feelings.
新聞記者用不帶感情的語氣描述這場意外，沒有流露任何個人情緒。
carbon neutral: The company plans to become carbon neutral by 2050 by planting trees and using only solar and wind power.
這家公司計畫在2050年前透過植樹及只使用太陽能和風力發電來達成碳中和。
a noble cause: Raising money to build schools in poor villages is a noble cause that many students are proud to support.
募款在貧窮村莊興建學校是一項崇高的事業，許多學生都以支持它為榮。
a noble gesture: Giving all his prize money to the children's hospital was a noble gesture that made everyone admire the young athlete.
把所有獎金捐給兒童醫院是個高尚的舉動，讓大家都很敬佩這位年輕運動員。
of noble birth: In the past, only people of noble birth, such as the children of kings and lords, could attend the royal school.
過去只有出身貴族的人，例如國王和領主的子女，才能就讀皇家學校。
noble ideals: The founders of the charity were guided by noble ideals such as fairness, kindness, and equality for all people.
這個慈善機構的創辦人秉持著公平、善良和人人平等等崇高的理想。
noble gases: Helium and neon are noble gases, which rarely react with other chemicals in science experiments.
氦和氖是惰性氣體，在科學實驗中很少與其他化學物質發生反應。
a nonprofit organization: She works for a nonprofit organization that gives free meals to homeless people instead of trying to make money.
她在一個非營利組織工作，這個組織不以賺錢為目的，而是提供免費餐點給無家可歸的人。
the nonprofit sector: Many college graduates now choose jobs in the nonprofit sector because they want to help society, not just earn money.
現在許多大學畢業生選擇在非營利部門工作，因為他們想幫助社會，而不只是賺錢。
